component.name: Airgorah-RT
component.summary: WiFi security auditing tool, a Red Team fork of Airgorah

description.p: Airgorah-RT is a Red Team-focused fork of Airgorah, a WiFi security auditing tool that captures nearby WiFi traffic, discovers clients connected to access points, performs deauthentication attacks, captures handshakes and PMKIDs, and cracks access point passwords.
This fork adds a System/Light/Dark appearance setting and additional native packaging (including this Flatpak manifest) on top of the upstream Airgorah project by Martin Olivier.
Initial Airgorah-RT fork: Appearance (theme) setting and Flatpak packaging.
